specs.title: journey dark 1440px: A3/2 and B1/1, cancel, confirm, later login, B intact
journey light 375px: A3/2 and B1/1, cancel, confirm, later login, B intact
prior rating signals are gone after reset and reselection; cold start is non-personalised
keyboard order, focus return and dialog fit: dark 375px
keyboard order, focus return and dialog fit: dark 1440px
keyboard order, focus return and dialog fit: light 375px
keyboard order, focus return and dialog fit: light 1440px
duplicate submissions are blocked while one reset is pending
explicit failure, lost-before-commit and lost-after-commit keep truthful status and both watchlists
reset stays blocked while the profile read is unfinished
a delayed old profile response cannot overwrite a completed reset
a recommendations read in flight before the reset cannot restore old cards
